name: kiff
description: Connect an agent to KIFF through the MCP gateway, propose a Card for the owner, handle held calls without routing around the Card, and author kiff.yaml domains.

gateway_key.title: KIFF gateway key
gateway_key.description: This agent's KIFF gateway key, from KIFF Cloud: the agent's Tools tab, Connect to the KIFF gateway. It is bound to one agent and can only ask; never use an owner or admin key. Leave empty to use the skills without the gateway.
